articles.title: Europe’s Equity Bankers Bet on Capex Wave to Ride Out IPO Slump
articles.summary: Record spending on AI infrastructure and power grids is fueling a flurry of capital raises by listed companies, giving bankers one of their busiest starts in years and eclipsing the slowdown of initial public offerings in the region.
articles.author: Pablo Mayo Cerqueiro

articles.title: A Year Of Misplaced Fear (And Why It’s Time For Investors To Leave The Crowd)
articles.summary: Many venture capital LPs have reacted to recent economic uncertainty by concentrating investments in megafunds, mistaking perceived safety for better returns while potentially sacrificing the higher upside that venture investing is meant to deliver. In this guest commentary, Sara Zulkosky, co-founder and managing partner of Recast Capital, contends that smaller emerging VC managers are a more attractive source of long-term returns for investors willing to look beyond the crowd.
articles.author: Guest Author

articles.title: GPT and Claude failed Bridgewater's finance tests because the right answers were never public
articles.summary: The hedge fund Bridgewater and Thinking Machines Lab report that a finely tuned open-weight model outperforms the most powerful AI models in the evaluation of financial documents, at a fraction of the cost.
